title: Lecture-to-text alignment (v1, RESERVED)
description: PLACEHOLDER — shape reserved, no files published yet. One file per lecture (/data/v1/alignments/<url-encoded lecture id>.json) mapping time ranges in the recording to chapter lines. Fields may still be added before first use; existing fields will not change meaning within v1.

lineId.description: id of the chapter line this range covers (chapter.schema.json $defs/line). Line ids are unique across all chapters; the build checks that the line exists in the named chapter.
